title: A blocked customer gets nothing new — only payment reminders

steps.do: New lead → convert for TB Defaulter Co.
steps.observed: Converting a lead for blocked TB Defaulter Co was not refused: "Done — TB Defaulter Co is now a customer, and an inquiry is raised for what they want. The inquiry is in Sales → inquiries." — the lead is CONVERTED and enquiry INQ-00001 was raised for the blocked customer.

steps.do: New enquiry, new quotation, Submit, Approve, Send, Mark accepted, register contract — each for TB Defaulter Co.
steps.expect: Each refused with one sentence naming the block and where it is cleared.
steps.observed: new enquiry: refused; new quotation: refused; Submit: refused; Approve: NOT refused as expected — "All approvals complete — quote approved and ready to send. (it was APPROVED)"; Send: refused; Mark accepted: refused; register contract: refused

steps.do: Money: invoice for work already done; payment reminder; receipt.
steps.expect: Still allowed (owner: invoicing work already done stays open).
steps.observed: Still allowed: a draft invoice started ("Draft invoice started. Check the lines, then issue it."); the night job wrote the overdue reminder naming TB Defaulter Co; the receipt was recorded ("Receipt RCP/2627/0001 recorded. Now say which invoices it settles.").

steps.do: As a manager: Left menu → Directory → Client holds → set Active.
steps.observed: Status "Active (no hold)" saved ("Hold cleared."); a new quotation for TB Defaulter Co is created again.
steps.note: Signed in as Test BranchMgr (a manager) for the Client holds screen.
